action.objective: Verify Qe4 as an alternative at full depth and compare with Qa8 before choosing the committed move.
action.rationale: Qa8+ is commit-ready at exact depth 4 (-144), but it was already played and Black answered ...Rf5, repeating the earlier Qa8/Rf5 shuffle. Replaying Qa8 risks threefold-repetition drawishness or just repeating. Qe4 was previously exact depth 4 (-136), slightly better, and avoids regress. I verify Qe4 fresh with full single-candidate nodes to compare like-for-like before committing.
